title: Verify UTC clock footer sizing across main and fixed-section pane hosts
outcome: Establish whether the clock shell flex-basis0 requires a height guarantee missing from any supported pane host, and preserve visible filters/body at narrow, normal and wide widths.
acceptance: Real-browser evidence covers main and fixed-section control panels at narrow, normal and wide widths and records usable shell/body/filter geometry with the footer present.
The indefinite-height concern is either disproved for all supported pane hosts with parent-height evidence, or fixed with an observable layout regression check.
